body.focus: ISSUE-b5a62f28: restoreCarriedDocSummaries (src/db/doc-summaries.ts:339-362) keeps a summary already stored for the document when it has no error and the same contentHash (keepGoodSummary); a stored placeholder is still replaced. The result counts kept rows; the full index log line (src/indexer/index.ts:745) reports them. Test in src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts.
body.summary: restoreCarriedDocSummaries now writes back with keepGoodSummary, so a good summary stored after the rebuild is kept and a stored placeholder is still replaced; the result and the full index's log line count keptGood. New test in doc-summary-carry.test.ts; db and indexer suites 860/860.
